Performance

Each return is labelled before or after fees. Past results do not predict future results.

Where figures come from

Each strategy names its data source: live account statements, an independent tracker, a backtest or a simulation. The label sits on every chart.

How we calculate

Monthly returns are compounded into the equity curve, starting at 100. Max drawdown is the biggest fall from a month-end high. Volatility is the spread of monthly returns.

Fees

Each strategy states whether its returns are before or after fees, and lists every fee. Until fees are published, no return is shown as "net".

Questions

Simple answers.

What is a Capital 50 AI strategy?

Software that runs one money-making approach on its own, such as trading gold or crypto. Kitchen Money AI combines all of them in one balance.

Can I lose money?

Yes. Any strategy can have losing months, and you can lose some or all of what you invest. Only invest money you can afford to lose.

Are past results a guide to the future?

No. Published records show what happened before. They don't predict or promise what will happen next.

How much do I need to start?

Rs 5,000.

When can I deposit?

Deposits are not open yet. Fees, deposit and withdrawal details, and how funds are held will be published before they open.

Who is behind Capital 50 AI?

Capital 50 AI is a company registered in Ecuador, registration no. 895897786. See Company & policies for what else is published.
